1  reconsidering the award dated 10.01.2022 by strictly following the proc  contemplated under Section 26 to 30 of the Right to Fair Compensation a  Transparency in land Acquisition,Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2  (Central Act 30 of 2013) and refix the compensation as per the provisio  Central Act 30 of 2013 within a time frame to be fixed by this Court an  following the procedures contemplated under Section 18 to 27 of the  Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
 For Petitioner : Mr.J.Ramesh  For Respondents 1 to 3 : Mr.A.Selvendran  Special Government Pleader
For respondent 4 : Mr.Su.Srinivasan  ORDER
The petitioner herein seeks a direction to 1st respondent to pass arbitration award by considering his claim petition dated 18.02.2022 seeking enhancement of the compensation.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 2

. It is the case of the petitioner that the land of the petitioner situated in Survey No.288/4A1 to an extent of 75 cents and Survey No. 288/4A2 to an extent of 95 cents at Pillari Agraharam Village,
Denkanikottai Taluk, Krishnagiri District was acquired for extension of National Highways and not satisfied with the quantum of compensation fixed by the Land Acquisition Officer
, the petitioner submitted the claim petition seeking enhancement of the compensation.

3. A.Selvendran, learned Special Government Pleader, who takes notice for the respondents 1 to 3 submitted that the matter was already referred to arbitration by District Collector and he issued notice for enquiry on 29.09.2023.

4. In view of the said position that the matter is already referred to arbitration by 1st respondent and he also initiated arbitral proceedings, without going into the merits of the claim made by the petitioner, this Court is inclined to direct the 1st respondent to complete the arbitral proceedings and pass final award on merits within a period of three months from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 5.
With the above directions, this writ petition is disposed of.
No costs.
